name: Vintage Salt-N-Pepa Rap T-shirt
description: Own a piece of hip-hop history. This vintage Salt-N-Pepa graphic tee is the ultimate nod to the golden era of female rap. A true vintage piece with the perfect worn-in softness and slight fading that only comes with time.

name: Vintage Outkast "The South Got Something To Say" Rap T-shirt
description: The South got something to say — and this tee says it loud. This vintage Outkast graphic tee is a true piece of Southern hip-hop history. Printed on a classic blue cotton t-shirt, the front features a vibrant, high-contrast image of André 3000 and Big Boi with the iconic phrase 'The South Got Something To Say' — a direct nod to André 3000's legendary 1995 Source Awards speech that helped put Atlanta on the map. A true vintage piece with the perfect worn-in softness and slight fading that only comes with time.

name: Vintage Naughty by Nature Rap T-Shirt
description: Hip-hop hooray — this tee is a genuine piece of 90s rap history. This vintage Naughty by Nature graphic tee features a bold, high-contrast print of Treach, Vin Rock, and DJ Kay Gee in their signature streetwear, with a red brushstroke backdrop and a baseball bat graphic anchoring the bottom. Named after the New Jersey neighborhood they grew up in, Naughty by Nature defined East Coast hip-hop in the early 90s with anthems like 'O.P.P.' and 'Hip Hop Hooray.' A true vintage piece with the perfect worn-in softness that only comes with time.

name: Vintage Beastie Boys "Check Your Head" Rap T-Shirt
description: Check your head — this tee is a genuine piece of 90s hip-hop history. This vintage Beastie Boys graphic tee features a bold blue print of the trio's name and album title framing a classic black-and-white photo from their 'Check Your Head' era. Released in 1992, the album marked a pivotal shift for the Beastie Boys, blending punk, funk, and jazz into a sound that would define their legacy. A true vintage piece with the perfect worn-in softness that only comes with time.

name: Vintage DMX Rap Tee – 90s Hip-Hop Black T-Shirt – Rare Retro Ruff Ryders Graphic
description: Stop, drop, shut 'em down this new to you vintage t-shirt is a genuine piece of 90s hip-hop history. This vintage DMX graphic tee features a high-contrast black-and-white print of the rapper mid-performance, gripping a mic with both hands, framed by the iconic pink gothic 'DMX' logo beneath. One of the most raw and influential voices in East Coast hip-hop, DMX defined the late 90s with anthems like 'Ruff Ryders' Anthem,' 'Party Up,' and 'X Gon' Give It to Ya.' A true vintage piece with the perfect worn-in softness that only comes with time.

name: Vintage Michael Jackson "Beat It" T-Shirt
description: Just beat it, in this new to you vintage female t-shirt. This vintage Michael Jackson graphic tee features a bold gold glitter-style 'BEAT IT' print framing the King of Pop himself in his iconic red zipper jacket and silver glove from the legendary 'Beat It' music video. Released in 1983 as part of the record-breaking Thriller album, the song and its video helped define the MTV era and cemented Michael Jackson as the biggest pop star on the planet. A true vintage piece with the perfect worn-in softness that only comes with time.

name: Vintage A Tribe Called Quest Rap T-Shirt

A true nod to the Native Tongues collective and the golden era of alternative hip-hop, this piece captures the era that gave us 'Bonita Applebum,' 'Scenario,' and 'Electric Relaxation.' A true vintage piece with the perfect worn-in softness that only comes with time.
